title: Air and Water
seo_title: Grade 2 Science: Air and Water Worksheets (Ontario Curriculum)
standard_text: Describe the properties of air and water; explain that air takes up space and moves as wind; describe how water changes and moves in the environment. (summary of the Ontario Science and Technology curriculum, 2022, Strand E: Earth and Space Systems – Air and Water in the Environment)
meta_desc: Free Grade 2 science worksheets on air, wind, water, rain, clouds and the water cycle, with pictures. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Moving air is wind. Water falls as rain or snow, dries up and makes clouds.
body_html:
How to think about it

Air and water are all around us.

  • We cannot see air, but we feel wind.
  • Water can be liquid, solid ice or water vapour.
  • Rain falls, puddles dry up, clouds form.
Example

What is wind?

air that moves

Answer: moving air

Example

Where does a puddle go?

sun warms it

Answer: into the air

Common mistakes

  • Thinking air is nothing.
  • Thinking clouds are made of smoke or cotton.
